title: The Good Fence Hour
description: Ronnie answers your neighbor and HOA disputes on Snazzie FM. Every problem, no matter how unrelated, has the same fix: build a taller fence. Barry would like a word.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Welcome back to The Good Fence Hour. Let's open the mailbag.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Diane on Maple Court writes, the HOA fined me four hundred dollars because my mailbox is the wrong shade of beige.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Easy one, Diane. Build a taller fence around the mailbox so they can't see the color.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: They still deliver her mail, Ronnie. They'll see it.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Which is exactly why the fence has to be tall, Barry. Next letter.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Carol says the HOA president parks his boat in the visitor spots, then fines everyone else for parking there.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Carol, build a fence around the visitor spots.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: That fences in his boat with him still inside it, Ronnie.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: I mean... it would technically work.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Quick update. Diane built a twelve foot fence around her mailbox. <p:0.3> The HOA fined her another four hundred. For the fence.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: See, Barry, that's her mistake. <p:0.3> Should've built it taller.
